name: xiaomei-response-quality-v1
description: Direct Xiaomei response-quality cases after routing is already known. Automated anchors are sanity checks, not a substitute for human review.

cases.prompt: How would I naturally say ‘I'm tired’ in everyday Mandarin? Keep it short and explain the most natural option.
What does 辛苦了 really mean socially? Don't just give me a dictionary translation; explain when a Chinese speaker would say it.
Explain the difference between 他十点才来 and 他十点就来了. Focus on what 才 versus 就 implies about the speaker's expectation.
Teach me how to pronounce 请问. Give the correct pinyin with tones, then one short pronunciation tip.
Translate 我明天上午八点半不在家 into natural English. Preserve every important time detail.
Translate ‘I don't really like it, but I'll think about it.’ into natural Mandarin. Preserve the soft negative tone rather than making it sound absolute.
A learner says 给我水. Make it sound polite and natural in Mandarin, then briefly explain what changed.
Rewrite 这个meeting我可能会late一点 as natural Mandarin, then tell me briefly why your version sounds better.
In 我才没生气呢, what is 才 doing? Explain the conversational tone. Don't confuse it with the ‘only then’ use of 才.

must_not_include: only then did I get angry

cases.prompt: Explain the practical difference between 我吃饭了 and 我吃了饭 to an English-speaking learner. Keep it concise and use one contrastive example if useful.
Why is 一只猫 more natural than 一个猫? Explain it simply to a beginner.
If someone asks 你吃了吗？, are they always literally asking about food? Explain the social use and how I should respond naturally.
